relevant_behavior: RestoreAdmission restores the prior global ShapeAdmission; it is the first object and therefore restores last.
Session is noncopyable/nonmovable; its destructor finalizes/reports only when it owns the root timing session.
RestoreBudgetWindow snapshots the shared budget fields and restores them in its destructor.
The geometry view and lease are declared after RestoreBudgetWindow and are destroyed before the budget window restores its snapshot.
The lease is declared after atlas_geometry and therefore is released before the atlas geometry object.
